newsitem.title: USA: Grant Geophysical to sell stake to 2 cos.
newsitem.headline: Grant Geophysical to sell stake to 2 cos.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said it had signed a non-binding letter of intent to give two companies shares of its common stock in exchange for $20 million.
Grant said it would give the shares to Westgate International LP and affiliate Elliott Associates LP at a 20-percent discount. Its shareholders would have to approve some parts of the agreement.
Westgate and Elliott already own about 30 percent of its outstanding preferred stock.
Grant offers geophysical services like seismic testing for oil and gas companies.
The company had said that it had been evaluating several financial proposals regarding its debt and capital structure.

On August 20, Grant said it had won two contracts worth nearly $20 million to do seismic tests in South America, one of them in Venezuela. It will begin work on the contracts in the fourth quarter of the year and finsh them in the first half of the next.
